The senate would have 3 members elected for each member regardless of population. It would elect a speaker to act as the signatory for the senate.

The house would have members elected based on population, one for every two thousand citizens a member nation has. They would elect a speaker to act as the signatory for the house.

The presidency would rotate on a two year term, between the executive council members head of state. The president will act as the signatory for COP.

Any member part of the executive council could veto any bill. New members may be brought on to the council by unanimous decision of the council.

The Constitution would also set limits on the government so that it would not infringe upon any member states sovereignty, although it would establish a separate diplomatic entity similar to the EU.
